title: Rainy August cast gloom on PH vehicle sales
summary: MANILA, Philippines — Weather disruptions in August put the Philippine car industry back in a bleak spot, as sales fell below the 30,000 mark, upending the short-lived recovery seen in June and July.…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Weather disruptions in August put the Philippine car industry back in a bleak spot, as sales fell below the 30,000 mark, upending the short-lived recovery seen in June and July. Domestic vehicle sales reached just 29,611 units in August, down from the 36,174 units sold in the same month last year, according to […]...
